1. Who we are

KenganSocial is operated by MiraiStack (registration number K2025971590), a company registered in the Republic of South Africa and based in Durban, KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa.

MiraiStack is the responsible party for personal information processed through KenganSocial (https://kengansocial.co.za), as defined in the Protection of Personal Information Act 4 of 2013 (POPIA).

When you use KenganSocial to manage your social media accounts and your audience's messages, you decide why and how that audience data is used, and MiraiStack processes it on your behalf as an operator under POPIA.

Information Officer: privacy@kengansocial.co.za

2. Information we collect

Account information: your name, email address, password (handled by Google Firebase Authentication; we never see it), profile photo if you sign in with Google, workspace name, industry, and the consent records you accept during onboarding.

Content you create: videos, images, audio, captions, drafts, schedules, automation rules and reply templates you upload or write in KenganSocial.

Connected account information: when you connect a social account, we receive an access token and the account details described in "Data from connected platforms" below. Tokens are encrypted before they are stored.

Information about other people: if you turn on comment or message automation, we receive the comments and direct messages people send to your connected accounts, with their public name, username, profile picture and platform user ID, so that we can show them in your Inbox and reply on your behalf.

Billing information: your plan and payment status. Payments are handled by Payfast; we do not receive or store card numbers.

Free starter clip (no account): if you use the free clip on our home page, we receive the video you upload and your email address. We keep only a one-way fingerprint (a keyed hash) of your email, so we can make sure each person gets one free clip; we keep the email address itself only if you ask us to send you product news. We also keep a fingerprint of your network address to limit free clips per network per day.

Technical information: IP address, browser type, device type, pages used and error logs, kept to run, secure and fix the service.

3. Data from connected platforms

We only request the permissions a feature you use needs, and we only use platform data to provide that feature to you.

Instagram (Meta): your professional account's ID, username, profile picture and follower count; the posts and Reels you publish through us; comments on your posts; direct messages sent to your account; and account insights. Used to publish and schedule your posts, show your comments and messages in the Inbox, send the replies and automated responses you set up, and show your analytics.

Facebook Pages (Meta): the Pages you choose to connect, with their name, picture and follower count; posts you publish through us; comments on your Page's posts; Messenger conversations with your Page; and Page insights. Used for the same purposes as Instagram.

Meta Ads: the ad accounts you choose to connect, with their campaigns, ad sets, ads, budgets and performance results. Used to show your ad results and, only when you confirm an action, to create, pause or edit campaigns and budgets. We never spend money or change an ad without your explicit confirmation in KenganSocial.

TikTok: your TikTok open ID, display name and avatar; the videos you publish through us and their publishing status; and, for TikTok Business accounts you connect for automation, comments on your videos and direct messages sent to your account. Used to publish your videos, show their status, and reply to comments and messages as you set up.

YouTube: your channel's ID, name, thumbnail and subscriber count; the videos you upload through us; your channel's video list and statistics; and comments on your videos. Used to upload and schedule videos, show your videos and analytics, and reply to comments.

What we never do with platform data: we do not sell it; we do not use it for advertising, profiling or to build audience lists for anyone else; we do not use it to train or improve artificial intelligence models; and we do not share it with other customers. Each workspace's data is kept separate from every other workspace.

4. YouTube API Services

KenganSocial uses YouTube API Services. By connecting a YouTube channel you agree to be bound by the YouTube Terms of Service (https://www.youtube.com/t/terms). Google's Privacy Policy (https://policies.google.com/privacy) describes how Google handles your information.

You can revoke KenganSocial's access to your Google account at any time at https://myaccount.google.com/permissions, or by disconnecting YouTube on the Connections page. When access is revoked, we delete the YouTube data we stored within 7 days.

Google API Services User Data Policy: KenganSocial's use and transfer of information received from Google APIs to any other app will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy (https://developers.google.com/terms/api-services-user-data-policy), including the Limited Use requirements. We do not transfer Google user data to others except as needed to provide the features you use, to comply with the law, or as part of a merger with your notice; we do not use it for advertising; and we do not let people read it unless you ask us to (for support), it is needed for security or the law, or it has been aggregated and anonymised.

5. How we use information

To provide the service: create your account and workspaces, publish and schedule your content, run the automations you configure, show your Inbox and analytics, edit and render your videos, and process payments.

To keep it working and safe: prevent abuse and unauthorised access, enforce platform rate limits, fix errors and keep records the law requires.

To communicate with you: service notices about your account, posts, connections and billing. Marketing emails are sent only with your consent, and you can withdraw consent at any time.

We do not use your content, your connected account data or your audience's messages to train AI models, and we do not make automated decisions about you that have legal or similarly significant effects.

6. Artificial intelligence features

Some features send content to an AI provider to produce a result for you: writing captions and posts, suggesting or sending replies to comments and messages you have set to automate, transcribing and finding highlights in your videos, and creating images.

Only the content needed for the request is sent (for example, the text of one message and your reply instructions). Providers process it to return the result and, under their API terms, do not use it to train their models. AI-written replies are only sent automatically when you have switched that automation on; otherwise they wait in your Inbox for approval.

AI providers we use: OpenRouter (which routes requests to model providers such as Anthropic), OpenAI, Google (Gemini), Perplexity (trend research, without your account data), Pollinations (image generation) and AssemblyAI (transcription).

7. Who we share information with

Service providers who process data for us under contract: Google Cloud and Firebase (sign-in, database and file storage), our cloud hosting and file storage provider, Payfast (payments; Paystack for subscriptions started before 23 October 2026), Redis hosting (job queues), and the AI providers listed above.

Social platforms: when you publish, reply or change an ad, we send that content or instruction to the platform you chose. The platform's own terms and privacy policy then apply.

Your workspace: members you invite to your workspace, and clients you share a review link with, can see the content you give them access to.

The law: when we are legally required to, for example by a court order, or to protect people from harm or fraud.

Business transfer: if MiraiStack is merged or sold, information may transfer to the new owner, who must keep this policy's protections. We will tell you first.

We never sell personal information.

8. How we protect information

Access tokens for connected accounts are encrypted with AES-256-GCM before storage and are only decrypted on our servers when needed to act for you. They are never sent to your browser.

Data is sent over HTTPS. Each request is checked so that one workspace can never read or change another workspace's data, and messages from platforms are verified with their signatures before we process them.

Access to production systems is limited to people who need it. If a breach affects your personal information, we will notify you and the Information Regulator as POPIA section 22 requires.

9. International transfers

Some of our service providers store or process data outside South Africa, including in the United States and the European Union. We only use providers that are bound by data protection laws or contractual terms giving protection comparable to POPIA, as section 72 of POPIA requires.

10. How long we keep information

Connected account tokens: until you disconnect the account, or the platform tells us (or shows us, by refusing access) that you removed KenganSocial. Then they are deleted immediately.

Data fetched from a connected account (messages, comments, profile details, analytics): deleted within 7 days after that account is disconnected or its access is revoked.

Your account and workspace content: kept while your account is active, and deleted within 30 days after you delete your workspace or account.

Billing records: 5 years, as South African tax law requires.

Free starter clip: the video you upload is deleted as soon as your clip is made (or the attempt fails), and the finished clip after 72 hours. The fingerprint of your email is kept so the free clip stays one per person; if you asked for product news, your email is kept until you unsubscribe or ask us to delete it.

Security and error logs: up to 12 months.

11. Deleting your data and revoking access

Disconnect one account: Connections page → the account → Disconnect. We revoke our access with the platform where it allows this, delete the token at once, and delete that account's stored data within 7 days.

Delete your whole account: Settings → Delete account. This removes your workspaces, content, connections and automations.

Remove KenganSocial on the platform itself: — Facebook: Settings & privacy → Settings → Business integrations (https://www.facebook.com/settings?tab=business_tools), then remove KenganSocial. — Instagram: Settings → Apps and websites (https://www.instagram.com/accounts/manage_access/), then remove KenganSocial. — TikTok: Settings and privacy → Security → Manage app permissions, then remove KenganSocial. — Google / YouTube: https://myaccount.google.com/permissions, then remove KenganSocial.

When you remove us on Facebook or Instagram, Meta notifies us automatically and we delete your data and give you a confirmation code you can check on our data deletion page (https://kengansocial.co.za/data-deletion).

Full instructions, including for people who are not KenganSocial users but have messaged or commented on a KenganSocial customer's account: https://kengansocial.co.za/data-deletion

12. Your rights

Under POPIA you may ask to see the personal information we hold about you, ask us to correct or delete it, object to its processing, and withdraw consent you have given. Email privacy@kengansocial.co.za; we reply within 30 days and may first need to confirm your identity.

You may also complain to the Information Regulator of South Africa: https://inforegulator.org.za, complaints.IR@inforegulator.org.za.

If you live in the European Union, the United Kingdom or California, you have similar rights under the GDPR, UK GDPR or CCPA, and can use the same email address to exercise them.

13. Cookies and local storage

We use only what is needed to keep you signed in and remember your preferences (for example, your theme and editor layout), stored in your browser's local storage by Firebase Authentication and our app. We do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.

14. Children

KenganSocial is for people aged 18 and older. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has given us personal information, email privacy@kengansocial.co.za and we will delete it.

15. Changes to this policy

If we make a material change, we will email account owners and show a notice in the app at least 30 days before it takes effect. The date at the top shows when this policy last changed.
